updates.sentence: Initial U.S. custody episode for Kevin Barry Artt (register 33020-198): arrested and detained on June 3, 1992; released on bail on January 10, 1996. The court records electronic monitoring and other restrictions after release, which are not counted as imprisonment here. Later return to custody in the extradition proceedings is a separate episode and is not included in this interval. These dates are not the dates of his earlier Northern Ireland imprisonment.
